research: research/2026-10-28 (14 Oct data re-scored; new scrape refused, unpaid Apify invoices) + research/2026-10-14 pattern and ideas + research/demand-map.csv

posts.hook: Nuk të duhen më shumë ndjekës. Të duhen më pak klientë që humbasin rrugës.
posts.idea: You don't need more followers; you need fewer clients lost on the way: one line that swaps the follower count for the clients lost after they write
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #7 @hormozi one-line reframe (3.0x); brain AV-01 false_beliefs ('I need more followers or more ads')
posts.hypothesis: Reframing the follower goal gets more sends than W1-01's phone reframe

posts.hook: Pas ofertës: 5 pyetje që tregojnë ku ikën klienti
posts.idea: After the quote: 5 yes/no questions that show where a buyer goes once you send a price (what they compare you with, an agreed next step, a follow-up when they go quiet, why the last lost quote was lost, what happens if they say yes)
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #1 @eri.businesscoach numbered owner self-check (30.3x); map pillar Close (quote, follow-up)
posts.hypothesis: A self-check on the quote stage gets ANALIZA comments from owners who send quotes and wait

posts.idea: Before you switch off the ad that 'doesn't work', follow the messages it brought: were they answered, followed up, given a next step? The ad did its job; the message had no owner
based_on: vault C3 ('Your ads aren't failing. Your enquiries are dying after the click.')
posts.hypothesis: Stopping the owner at the moment he switches an ad off gets more sends than a general 'ads aren't the problem' line

posts.hook: Marketer i ri apo sistem? Pyetja më e mirë është tjetër.
posts.idea: Hire a marketer or build a system? The better question: what the hire needs on day one (the buyers' words, one message, a path after the click, the numbers); a hire without it becomes one more piece
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #12 @florina.marketing 'better question' reframe carousel; brain mechanism.ump (Patchwork Marketing)
posts.demand_phrase: kush duhet ta bëjë marketingun tim
posts.hypothesis: Reframing the hiring decision moves owners who are about to hire to ask for the analysis

posts.idea: Before your next ad, open the public ad library and check 3 things in your category: which ads have run the longest, what they all promise, and what none of them says; what nobody says is your ad
based_on: content-map series Ad Library Spy (OS 12); the public ad library as the method
posts.hypothesis: A method the owner can repeat tonight gets sends to whoever makes the ads

posts.hook: Klienti heshti. Mesazhi i dytë që i dërgon.
posts.idea: Convert, this week's one step: the second message to a lead who went quiet: one line that names what they asked, one question, one next step; written once and saved as a template
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #1 numbered self-check device (30.3x); OS 7.2 level-4 example (the message to a lead who went silent); One Step, Convert step
posts.hypothesis: Giving the exact message gets more saves than One Step #1's question

posts.hook: Kush ishte klienti i parë që të besoi, kur s'të njihte askush?
posts.idea: Who was the first client who trusted you when nobody knew you? A warm owner question that gets owners telling why buyers chose them
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #3 @eri.businesscoach owner question image (7.8x); pattern.txt: posts about the owner beat tips
posts.demand_phrase: klientët vijnë nga rekomandimet, jo çdo muaj
posts.hypothesis: A warm owner-identity question gets more comments per reach than the fear question of W1-06
